comment: Final continuation of the universal transition PPO campaign. The only change against ppo_universal_transition_generic_sequence_v5_rewarm_fixed.json is the hard_case_mixture below (35% procedurally generated hard TRAIN geometry) plus a conservative learning rate and a denser evaluation cadence. Reward, observation and action contracts are untouched.

initialization.comment: Parent chosen by the pre-registered matched validation benchmark: 560 identical VALIDATION cases per candidate (500 transition plus 10 sequences at each of 3/5/8/12/17/22 gates), 2800 cases in total. Plan fingerprint c9065d25, selection rule fingerprint 3db79364, both recorded at git 4278c6c before any case ran.
initialization.reshard_reason: unchanged 2x1024; the continuation changes the training distribution, not the rollout geometry
initialization.selection_reason: ppo_729088: transition success 0.788 (95% CI [0.750,0.822], n=500), sequence completion 0.500 (95% CI [0.377,0.623], n=60), 41 collision episodes of 560. Its paired difference against ppo_528384 on the same cases was +0.0143 with 95% CI [-0.0214,+0.0500] and sign-test p=0.49, so the two are statistically indistinguishable and the pre-registered rule broke the tie on safety, which ppo_729088 wins clearly (41 collisions against 60). ppo_628736 was also a tie (-0.0321, CI [-0.0661,+0.0018]). The two later checkpoints were decisively worse: ppo_901120 by +0.1214 (CI [+0.0857,+0.1571]) and ppo_935936 by +0.0821 (CI [+0.0464,+0.1179]), both p<0.0001 -- training past ~730k degraded the policy.
initialization.predecessor_defect: Every PPO run of this campaign trained only at G1 (max turn 8 deg, max vertical step 0.20 m, lateral offset 0.35 m): promotion to G2 requires >=0.99 success AND zero safety events across a whole evaluation, which never happened, so the controller has never seen geometry resembling a real circuit. The curriculum alone cannot fix that, because the gate that blocks it is the gate the geometry is supposed to open.

new_environment_steps_comment: ABSOLUTE cumulative target, not an increment: the trainer computes target = (value // rollout_size) * rollout_size with rollout_size = n_envs * n_steps = 2048, and trains while model.num_timesteps < target starting from the parent's 729088. 929792 is 454 rollouts exactly, so this run adds 200704 new transitions.

hard_case_mixture.comment: 65% of episodes stay on the S0 distribution the policy is already competent on; 35% are drawn from rl_hard_families.HARD_FAMILY_SPECS, which reach geometry G1 cannot express at all (G1 caps turns at 8 deg and vertical steps at 0.20 m). Weights are derived from the failure mining on ppo_729088, not chosen a priori: the dominant failure is the target switch at the FIRST transition (poor_target_switch = 59.6% of failures, all at gate position 2), so short 2-4 gate families that make that switch the whole episode carry the most weight, while long_chain_accumulation carries least because survivors of gate 2 already chain to 22 gates at ~1.0 conditional rate. MAX_HARD_FRACTION is 0.50, so base_fraction may not go below 0.50.

evaluation.early_schedule_comment: Empty on purpose: the early schedule is expressed in absolute transition counts, which cannot be written before the parent's total is known. The 50000 frequency already evaluates four times across the intended 200000 new transitions; add explicit early points only if the chosen parent warrants a denser start.

provenance.change: training distribution only: 35% hard TRAIN geometry mixed into the rollout workers, evaluation cadence 100000 -> 50000, learning rate 7e-06 -> 4.5e-06. Architecture, reward, observation, action contract, rollout geometry and evaluation case counts unchanged.
provenance.learning_rate_reason: The campaign's learning-rate history is fraught: v4 advertised 7e-06 and silently ran at 3.489754098360656e-06 because the parent's exhausted ratcheting schedule was restored on top of it. 4.5e-06 is deliberately conservative - the hard mixture is itself a large distribution shift, and a shifted distribution plus an aggressive rate is how a competent policy is lost. _install_continuation_schedule and assert_learning_rate_applied verify the rate actually reaches every optimizer param group.
provenance.hard_case_reason: rl_hard_families existed but nothing constructed it, so its mixture had never been observed on a real rollout worker. This run is the first that samples it: status.json carries the realised base/hard split and per-family counts, and logs/episode_composition.jsonl records case_source and hard_family per episode.
